routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: EU, Swiss, Icelandic, Liechtenstein and Norwegian citizens can enter with an ID card that has a photo. Third-country nationals on the EU visa-exempt list can stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Cyprus is not in Schengen yet, so its visas and permits only count for Cyprus for now.

other: Visa-exempt nationalities follow Part B of the EU common visa list (Annex 1), linked on the official visas page.

Holders of a Cyprus entry permit, Cyprus residence permit, or a valid two or multiple entry Schengen visa, or a national visa or residence permit from a Schengen state, do not need a short-stay visa for up to 90 days in 180. Turkish and Azerbaijani citizens are excluded from that Schengen-document rule.

Cyprus has not yet joined the Schengen area, so days spent in Cyprus are counted separately for now. After full Schengen integration its visas and permits will give 90 days in 180 in the rest of Schengen.

routes.name: Short Stay Visa (Type C)
routes.summary: Uniform short-stay visa for stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period, apply at a Cyprus embassy or consulate (or its visa center). Multiple-entry visas can be valid 6 months to 5 years for frequent, trustworthy travelers.

other: Applies to nationalities that are not on the visa-exempt list.

stay.note: Extension up to 90 days from date of entry is possible only for force majeure or humanitarian reasons, free of charge. Extension for serious personal reasons costs 30 EUR. Not possible for visas issued at the border.

routes.name: Short Stay Visa issued at the border (LTV)
routes.summary: Only in emergencies, with approval of the Migration Department director. A uniform visa valid up to 15 days, or the time needed for transit. Cannot be extended.

other: Applicant could not apply in advance and shows unforeseeable, compelling reasons.
Applicant meets Schengen Borders Code conditions and return or onward travel is assured.

routes.name: Airport Transit Visa (ATV)
routes.summary: Nationals of certain countries need an airport transit visa even to change planes in Cyprus. The common EU list and the extra list for individual states are linked on the official page. Holders of a valid uniform visa or a national long-stay visa are exempt.

other: Check the common ATV list and the extra Cyprus list (Annex 7A and 7B) for your nationality.

routes.name: Digital Nomad Visa
routes.summary: Residence route for non-EU remote workers, for up to 3 years. Invest Cyprus gives no other terms. Income and employer rules were not confirmed on an official page I could open.

other: Income, employer, fee and quota rules not confirmed. The Migration Department and Civil Registry sites would not load in the browser. Check the Cyprus Migration Department digital nomad page before applying.

routes.name: Temporary Work and Residence Permit (non-EU employees)
routes.summary: Non-EU employees can get a temporary work and residence permit of up to 3 years, renewable. Gov.cy confirms permits for remunerated employment, domestic employment and employment in companies of foreign interests, renewed online through CY Login. Exact conditions not confirmed.

other: Spouses of employees earning at least 2,500 EUR gross per month get free access to the labor market, per Invest Cyprus. Other conditions not confirmed.
Invest Cyprus also lists a 50% income tax exemption for new non-domiciled employees earning 55,000 EUR or more, valid 17 years. That is a tax rule, not an immigration rule.

routes.name: Employment in Companies of Foreign Interests
routes.summary: A separate temporary residence permit category for third-country employees of foreign-owned companies. Gov.cy confirms the category and that family members can get a family reunification permit. Conditions, quotas and fees not confirmed.

other: Conditions, staffing quotas, salary minimums and fees not confirmed on an official page I could open.

sources.label: Gov.cy: Renewal of residence permits for third country nationals

routes.name: Invest Cyprus Business and Relocation Facilitation
routes.summary: Invest Cyprus is the official agency that helps foreign companies set up and relocate staff and family. It is a support service. Residence terms for founders and investors were not confirmed.

other: Permit conditions for investors and founders not confirmed. Contact Invest Cyprus or the Migration Department.

routes.name: Long-Term Resident status
routes.summary: Cyprus has a long-term resident residence permit for third-country nationals, renewable online. Gov.cy also lists family reunification permits for family members of long-term residents. Years required and conditions not confirmed.

other: Years of residence, income, language and fee rules not confirmed on an official page I could open.

sources.label: Gov.cy: Renewal of residence permits for third country nationals

routes.name: Family Reunification Residence Permit
routes.summary: Temporary residence permit for family members of long-term residents and of employees in companies of foreign interests. Conditions and fees not confirmed.

other: Sponsor must be a long-term resident or an employee of a company of foreign interests, per Gov.cy. Other conditions not confirmed.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: Gov.cy confirms Cypriot citizenship can be acquired by descent, marriage or naturalization, each with its own procedure and form. Applications can go through Cyprus diplomatic missions. Years of residence, language test and dual citizenship rules not confirmed.

other: Residence years, language and test requirements not confirmed on an official page I could open.
